map.矩形房间轴向共振频率 使用指南: Rectangular Room Axial Resonant Frequency User Guide
map.房间轴向共振频率计算器，输入房间尺寸与模式阶数 n，按 f=n·c/(2L) 求: The Room Axial Resonant Frequency Calculator takes the room dimensions and mode order n and returns the axial standing-wave frequency of a rectangular room as f = n·c/(2L), which helps diagnose building acoustics defects.
map.f_n = n·c/(2L)。 5 m 房间基模 ≈ 34.3 Hz。: f_n = n·c/(2L). In a 5 m room the fundamental mode is ≈ 34.3 Hz.
map.输入房间尺寸与模式阶数 n，求轴向共振频率。: Enter the room dimensions and mode order n to get the axial resonant frequency.
map.填写「声速 c (m/s)」。: Enter the speed of sound c (m/s).
map.矩形房间沿长、宽、高方向的轴向简正频率 f=n·c/(2L)。: The axial normal frequencies of a rectangular room along the length, width and height are f = n·c/(2L).
map.预判小房间低频“轰鸣”或凹陷的频率点。: Predict the frequency points at which a small room booms or sounds hollow in the low end.
map.音箱摆位与听音位避开强模态区。: Keep the speaker positions and the listening position out of the strong modal regions.
map.：房间长度 L=5 m、声速 c=343 m/s，第一轴向模态 f1=c/(2L: Room length L=5 m and speed of sound c=343 m/s give a first axial mode f1 = c/(2L) = 34.3 Hz and a second at 68.6 Hz, which reveals how the low-frequency standing waves are distributed.

map.由声功率求声功率级（W₀=10⁻¹² W）: Sound power level from sound power (W₀=10⁻¹² W)
map.由声压求声压级（p₀=20 µPa）: Sound pressure level from sound pressure (p₀=20 µPa)
map.轴向模态和斜向/切向模态区别？: How do axial modes differ from oblique and tangential modes?
map.轴向只沿一个维度（n 取一维），切向沿二维、斜向沿三维；轴向通常能量最强、最需关: Axial is along one dimension only (n takes a single dimension), tangential is two-dimensional and oblique is three-dimensional. The axial mode is usually the strongest energetically and the one that matters most.
map.小房间为什么低频难处理？: Why is low frequency hard to handle in a small room?
map.模态频率稀疏且集中在可听低频，相邻模态间出现声染色（某些频率过强或过弱）。: Modal frequencies are sparse and concentrated in the audible low range, so acoustic colouration appears between adjacent modes (some frequencies are too strong or too weak).
